verdict.rationale: Penpot documents its own open plugin API and plugin system that developers can build and publish extensions against, plus an access-token-authenticated API with extensive object and property access. That is an official programmatic surface, but no named, packaged SDKs or client libraries are evidenced, and probes found no published OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: explicitly named official SDK or client-library packages, language coverage, SDK reference docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of building with them.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Penpot MCP server is agnostic and enables high-quality multi-directional AI workflows through our world-class open plugin API.
Our plugin system brings the flexibility that devs need to create and publish their own custom extensions.
Get extensive access to objects and properties to enable external rendering, workflow automation, enhanced app functionality, and more.
They can allow an app to access Penpot's API.
